jobs.title: Catering Event Staff
jobs.body:
Provide great service at off site events. Ensure quality of products is up to standard throughout events. Load and set up events of many types including weddings, corporate picnics, graduation parties, etc. 

Flexible schedule, staffing needs dependent on number of events booked with the restaurant. 

18+ only for catering.

Hourly wage starts at $12-$13 plus tips from deliveries and events. 

Apply online at mission-bbq.com/join-our-team, make sure to select the Brunswick, Ohio location.

jobs.title: Music Teacher
jobs.body: Rios Guitar Co.& Music Store is looking for contract Music Teachers in all areas of music. Music Educational Background a strong plus. Experience teaching music also a plus. If you play an instrument or multiple instruments and want to teach, contact us for an interview at 645 Lafayette Road Medina, Ohio 44256 or call 1-330-725-8575
